title: Axe pass per main route with a seeded-violation fixture
goal: A browser test runs axe on each main route of Hobo
acceptance: The browser test visits `/` (the only route) and fails on serious or critical axe violations; moderate ones are listed in the output
A seeded fixture (an unlabeled input on a test-only page) proves the test fails when it should; findings on the real routes are fixed in the same step or recorded as records with ids
Failing test committed first: the seeded-violation fixture expects a failure before the axe pass is wired; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 3 h for the template helper split: a first use in Hobo is the same size plus a browser runner. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
